title: DOE and Battelle Institute as UFO secret keepers

tellings.quote: I kept poting the doe I kept asking about why people weren't Looking At Doe I kept asking why people weren't looking at the battel Institute

plain: The idea is that the Department of Energy, the US government agency in charge of energy and nuclear research, and the Battelle Institute, a private research organisation, may be where UFO secrets are kept. A researcher named Bob Maguire says he kept pointing at both and kept asking why people weren't looking at them, and he mentions a person named Linda Thompson along the way. If he is right, the search for hidden UFO knowledge has been looking in the wrong places.
